texts.zh: 这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
texts.en: Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

sections.zh:
自汗国存在以来，我们部族便一直在此。我们见证了辉煌的胜利、伟大的战役，以及可汗们的兴衰沉浮。

因此，当选举新可汗的时刻到来时，我们挺身而出，要求继承我们曾协助铸就的王位。这本该是属于我们的时刻，然而，我们却遭到了背叛。

我们最亲密的盟友煽动其他部落与我们为敌。我们的长者们被屠杀。我们为之浴血奋斗的梦想被窃取。

即便是现在，那些篡位者依然派出身手矫健的杀手追捕我们，仿佛我们的存在本身就玷污了他们窃取的统治名分。我们只是昔日辉煌血统的残余，被追捕，四处流散。

当我们归来时，复仇将会从怒火之中淬炼而出。
sections.en:
For as long as there has been a Khanate, our clan has been there. We were there for the triumphs, the great battles, the rise and fall of Khans.

So when the time came to name a new Khan, we stepped forward to claim the throne we helped to forge. This was to be our moment; instead, we were betrayed.

Our closest allies turned the other clans against us. Our elders were slain. The dream we bled for was stolen.

Even now, the usurpers dispatch their enforcers to hunt us down, as if our very existence offends their stolen rule. We are but remnants of a proud lineage, hunted and scattered.

When we return, our vengeance will be tempered in the fire of our rage.

texts.zh:
数月间，我们零星收到了少量外星佣兵与海盗在我们边境活动的报告。他们自称为[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并且似乎是一群流放者，来自[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系的拥挤空间站上的一个游牧战士文明。

他们平安无事地路过我们的边境，但警告我们不要冒犯[marauder_system.GetName]。[From.GetSpeciesName]没有所谓的集中政体，但他们有着不同的派系，相互之间不断争斗，并经常攻击相邻的恒星系。鉴于其庞大的成员数量与空间站造船能力，如果他们停止自相争斗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很可能会成为星系中的强大势力。
texts.en:
For several months now, we have received scattered reports of small numbers of alien mercenaries and privateers operating on the frontiers of our space. They call themselves the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and are apparently exiles from a nomadic warrior culture inhabiting overcrowded space stations in and around the [marauder_system.GetName] system.

Their passage near our space proceeded without incident, but they warned us against trespassing in [marauder_system.GetName]. There is no [From.GetSpeciesName] central government to speak of, but their various factions are engaged in constant infighting and often launch raids against neighboring star systems. Indeed, given their vast population and space-based production capability, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would likely be a significant galactic power if they ever stopped killing each other.

texts.zh:
曾经辉煌的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]游牧战士文明已经消亡了。[marauder_killer.GetName]的势力摧毁了最后一座容纳着其大部分成员的巨大空间站。幸存的难民们在星系中四散奔逃。

尽管可能有些[From.GetSpeciesName]海盗和佣兵成了漏网之鱼，失去太空居所对他们来说是一个无法挽回的致命打击。这彻底终结了他们的侵略生涯。
texts.en:
The once proud nomadic warrior culture of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is no more. Forces from the [marauder_killer.GetName] have destroyed the last of the massive space stations that housed the majority of their population. Refugees from their surviving civilian population have scattered across the galaxy.

Although some [From.GetSpeciesName] pirate and mercenary fleets may still be unaccounted for, the loss of their space dwellings is a devastating blow that they cannot recover from. This puts a definite end to their raiding.

texts.zh:
一支[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵的大舰队在[attacked_system.GetName]星系脱离了超空间！看来在我们摧毁他们最后一座空间站时，部署在其它地方而幸存的[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵们摒弃前嫌并联手合作了。

我们不清楚他们是如何躲开我们的探测器并抵达[attacked_system.GetName]的，但他们在公开频道上发布了一条信息。
texts.en:
A large fleet of [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries has translated out of hyperspace in the [attacked_system.GetName] system! It looks like all of the surviving [marauder_species.GetName] mercenary outfits that were deployed elsewhere when we smashed their last space station have put their differences aside and joined forces.

We are not certain how they managed to elude our sensor cover to reach [attacked_system.GetName], but they are transmitting a message on an open channel.

texts.zh:
致[Root.GetName]的卑鄙懦夫们：

既然你们毁了我们的家，我们也要烧了你们的。我们已一无所有——这都拜你们所赐。现在我们只求在战场上倒下，当我们踏上黄泉之路时，也要把你们所谓的战士一并带走。

准备好防御吧！
texts.en:
To the wretched cowards of the [Root.GetName]:

As you destroyed our homes, we shall now burn yours. We have nothing left to lose - you have made certain of that. All that we hope for now is to die in battle, and to take as many of your so-called warriors with us as possible when we journey into the Great Beyond.

Ready your defenses!

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的泥蛮们！你们砸了我们家，现在我们也来砸你们的！我们知道自己可能活不了，但我们也要尽量拉泥蛮垫背！

干掉所有泥蛮们！嗨咿咿咿嘢嘢嘢嘢！！！！
texts.en:
Dwamaks of the [Root.GetName]! You bash our homes, now we bash yours! We know we may not survive, but we take as many dwamaks with us as possible!

Death to all dwamaks! HYEEEEEIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!!!!

texts.zh:
致[Root.GetName]的背叛者们：

你们玷污了我们的圣地，谋害了无数子民。你们以为虚空之母会饶恕这些罪过吗？

虚空之母要求牺牲，我们必将遵从。这将是我们在这个邪恶世界上的最终谢幕。
texts.en:
To the apostates of the [Root.GetName]:

You have defiled our most sacred of spaces and murdered countless of Her subjects. Did you think that She of the Void would let these atrocities pass unanswered?

She demands sacrifice, and we shall deliver. It will be our last act in this wretched world.

texts.zh:
一支[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵的大舰队进入了[From.GetName]。看来在我们摧毁他们最后一座空间站时，部署在其它地方而幸存的[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵们摒弃前嫌联手合作了。

他们意图对家园的毁灭进行复仇，而截获的通讯表明，他们的战士打算与我们同归于尽。
texts.en:
A large fleet of [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries has crossed into the [From.GetName]. It looks like all of the [marauder_species.GetName] mercenary outfits who were deployed elsewhere when the [From.GetName] smashed their last space station have put their differences aside and combined forces.

They are intent on exacting vengeance for the destruction of their homes, and intercepted communications makes it clear that their warriors have no intention of surviving the campaign.

texts.zh:
一支由破旧杂货船组成的船队载着[marauder_species.GetName]难民抵达了我们的宇域，这批难民的母星系近期遭受了毁灭性打击。他们已被允许定居在[Root.GetName]。

尽管这些难民习惯居住在脏乱拥挤的空间站上，但他们似乎也很适应新的行星家园。但愿他们已经做好了准备抛弃自己作为掠劫者、海盗的过去。
texts.en:
A battered flotilla of tramp freighters carrying [marauder_species.GetName] refugees fleeing the recent destruction in their home systems have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.GetName].

Although these refugees are used to living on crowded space stations under squalid conditions, they seem to be adjusting well to their new planetary home. Hopefully they are ready to leave their past as raiders and pirates behind them.

texts.zh:
一支由破旧杂货船组成的船队载着[marauder_species.GetName]难民抵达了我们的宇域，这批难民的母星系近期遭受了毁灭性打击。他们已被允许定居在[Root.GetName]。

他们早已习惯了拥挤的空间站生活，现在正迅速熟悉我们的人造定居点。但愿他们已经做好了准备抛弃自己作为掠劫者、海盗的过去。
texts.en:
A battered flotilla of tramp freighters carrying [marauder_species.GetName] refugees fleeing the recent destruction in their home systems have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.GetName].

Already accustomed to living on crowded space stations they are quickly getting familiar with our artificial settlements. Hopefully they are ready to leave their past as raiders and pirates behind them.

label.zh: 我们将给他们安排新家。
label.en: We will give them new homes.

texts.zh:
外来者们。我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。不像星系中的其他“文明”的星际帝国，我们没有统治者，但作为被所有氏族选中的代表，我在此正告各位：

不要妄图用你们那软弱无力的威胁来挑战我们。你们尽管将自己的舰队派往[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]看看，千万不要期望它们能安然返航，我们的战士不介意进行些消遣。

当然，你们要是想进贡，那我们希望你们能常来坐坐……或在你们需要佣兵并能支付足够酬金的时候。
texts.en:
Outsiders. We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Unlike the "civilized" star nations of the galaxy, we have no single master to lord over us, but I have been chosen to convey this message to you on behalf of all of the Houses:

Do not try to impose your soft and effete ways upon us. You may freely send your alien ships into [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName] territory, but do not expect them to return. Our warriors will welcome the diversion, however.

Transmit on this frequency only if you wish to offer tribute... or if you have need of mercenaries, as well as the means to pay for them.

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！好多泥蛮啊！

你想怎样，愚蠢的泥蛮？你的脸是咋整的？反应堆事故？真空暴露？嗨咿咿嘢嘢！！你看看你！

我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们狩猎泥蛮。如果你来[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]领地，我们就做泥蛮汤。你不喜欢，对吧？嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！

或许你认识其他泥蛮们。或许你想让他们变成泥蛮汤。我们可以谈条件。如果价格公道，[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也愿意为泥蛮们去打其他泥蛮们。
texts.en:
HYEEEIIIIEEEE!!!! More dwamaks!

What you want, foolish dwamak? What happen to make your face look like that? Reactor accident? Vacuum exposure? HYEEIIIEE!! Look at you!

We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We hunt dwamak. If you come to [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName] turf, we make dwamak-stew. Not good for you, yes? HYEEIIIIIEEEEE!!

Perhaps you know other dwamaks. Perhaps you want them to be dwamak-stew. This can be arranged. [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural] not above fighting for dwamaks against other dwamaks, if price is right.

texts.zh:
我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，虚空之母的忠实仆人：她乃全知全能，统御太空的至高复仇者。

她让我们在很久以前放弃了先祖的行星家园，迁居她永恒的领域———冰冷的太空，赋予我们狩猎异端的使命，并献祭来取悦她。

可惜，信仰战争耗尽了我们的力量，并让我们产生了分歧。我们挣扎着寻求她的帮助，希望得到女神的指引，而毁灭异端异形无疑能取悦她————哪怕是因为接受其他异端的命令。因此，只要你出的起，我们许多信徒皆愿为你而战……
texts.en:
We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we are the favored servants of She of the Void; the All-Seeing, Ever-Knowing and above all Vengeful supreme being that lords over Space.

It was She that bade us give up our ancestral planetary home eons ago, to take up residence in Her eternal domain - the cold depths of space - so that we could hunt unbelievers and appease Her through sacrifice.

Alas, the Doctrinal Wars have sapped our strength and we are now a divided people, struggling to divine the true path She would have us walk. Yet Her favor can be won through the destruction of alien heretics - even at the behest of other heretics. Thus, many of our warriors are willing to fight your battles, for a price...

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]是自然的毒瘤。你们这种毫无荣誉概念的肮脏存在叫什么……“蜂巢思维”？还是什么都无所谓。你们简直是星系中能出现的所有错误的集合体。

[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的战士不愿与你们为伍。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] is a perversion of nature. Your... "Hive Mind" or whatever you wish to call the obscenity that lords over your domain has no concept of honor. It represents everything that is wrong in this galaxy.

The warriors of the [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will have nothing to do with you.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]只是一群蛮夷野人。你愚蠢地谋害无辜者，足以令我们最坚韧的战士感到恶心。

我们不会与你打交道。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] is nothing but a pack of savage animals. Your senseless slaughter of innocents is enough to make even our hardiest warriors sick.

We will have no dealings with you.

texts.zh:
啊，说话的机器。你的主人哪去了，机械脑袋？他们知道你出故障了吗？

如果你们再靠近我们的地盘，我们的战士会很乐意拿你们当靶子打，即便这样做毫无荣誉可言。现在快从俺们眼前消失吧。
texts.en:
Ah yes, the talking machines. Where are your owners, machine? Are they aware that you are malfunctioning?

Although there is no honor in it, our warriors will gladly use you for target practice if you approach our territory. Now be gone from my sight.

texts.zh: 你们恐怕自以为令人畏惧，就凭浑身火焰缠绕、地狱般的模样。或许你们忘了，火焰终究会被熄灭。拿你们那化为灰烬的言辞上别处说去吧。
texts.en: No doubt you think yourselves intimidating, with your infernal appearance wreathed in flame. Perhaps you've forgotten that every fire must eventually be snuffed out. Take your ashen words elsewhere.

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！什么都吃的蜂巢泥蛮！肯定不会让你把我们做成汤的！快走开，蜂巢泥蛮！
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEEE!!! The hive-dwamak that eats everything! You not turn us into stew, that for sure! Be gone, hive-dwamak!

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！我们喜欢砸，但不像你！你太喜欢了，泥蛮！我们不跟你说话！
texts.en: HYEEIIEEEE!!! We like bashing, but not like you! You like it too much, dwamak! We no talk to you!

texts.zh:
呀哈咿哈！！！！！！它、它能懂吗？它是杀戮机器，对吧？它只知道杀、杀、杀？

机械脑袋！自杀！我命令你把自己杀掉！

啊哈，它坏掉了，没用。
texts.en:
HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Can... can it understand? It killing machine, yes? It only kills?

Machine... kill self! You ordered to kill self!

Ah, it broken. No use.

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！又热又臭，闻着像烟味！能用来引火吗？不能？呸！

滚开，没用的炭渣！
texts.en:
HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Hot, hot, and stinks like smoke! Can use for kindling? No? Bah!

Go away, useless charcoal!

texts.zh:
你们是虚空之母的宿敌。如果可能的话，你们连虚空本身都会吞噬，对吧？

可恨的怪物。
texts.en:
Your kind is anathema to She of the Void. You would consume the Void itself were it possible, wouldn't you?

Abomination.

texts.zh: 虚空之母要求献祭，但不是你招致这种规模。你崇拜的是毁灭本身，这让你成为最邪恶的异端。
texts.en: She of the Void demands sacrifice, but not on the scale you deliver. You worship destruction itself, and that makes you the worst kind of heathen.

texts.zh:
你冰冷而空洞，就像虚空本身。虚空之母敬重这一点。所以你的毁灭将会使她感到非常愉悦。

仅此而已。
texts.en:
You are cold and empty, like the Void itself. She of the Void can respect that. Your destruction will bring us much favor with Her.

There is nothing more to be said.

texts.zh:
你竟敢将炽烈的火焰带入虚空之母的领地？你的本性令她憎恶。

像寒灰般寂静地速速离开。
texts.en:
You dare bring bright hot fire into the domain of She of the Void? Your nature is abhorrent to Her.

Be silent as cold ash and be gone.

label.zh: 你们都会如同他人一般燃烧殆尽！
label.en: You will burn like everyone else!

texts.zh: 说吧，外来者。我们的战士们正洗耳恭听。
texts.en: Speak then, outsider. Our warriors are listening.

texts.zh: 我们绝不向异形屈服。
texts.en: We bow to no alien.

texts.zh:
作为决斗失败的惩罚，我不得不按约定在这一轮中负责跟外来者打交道。

你来干哈？
texts.en:
As punishment for losing a duel, it has been decreed that I am to deal with all outsiders this cycle.

What do you want?

texts.zh: 解释一下你为什么要打扰我们。我们仍在继续战斗任务。
texts.en: Explain this interruption. There are battles to attend to.

texts.zh:
啊！终于来了个真正的军人！

[Root.GetSpeciesName]军队的战斗力我们也有所耳闻。成千上万的[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]迫切地想在战场上亲自挑战你们。
texts.en:
Ah! Now here is a true fighter at last!

The martial prowess of [Root.GetSpeciesName] warriors is known even to us. There are thousands of [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who would dearly like to test themselves in battle against you.

texts.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你的进贡使我们的战士非常高兴。

我直说吧……虽然还是有些人想要攻击你们，但他们已经被摆平了。至少摆平大多数了。
texts.en:
Well met, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your tribute has been well-received by our warriors.

I will not lie... there were some who still wished to attack you, but they have been dealt with. For the most part.

texts.zh: 吾等剑已归鞘，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。目前你们无需担忧。
texts.en: Our swords are sheathed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have nothing to fear from our warriors for now.

texts.zh: 我好端端的一个晚上被你给扰了，泥蛮！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！你想怎样？！
texts.en: I was having fine evening, and then you show up, dwamak! HYEEEIIIEEEEE!!! What you want?!

texts.zh: 唯一比泥蛮更糟的是泥蝻！不！别问那是什么！嗨咿咿咿嘢嘢嘢嘢！！！
texts.en: Only thing worse than a dwamak is a dwakam! NO! Do not ask what is! HYEEEIIIEEEEEEEEE!!!!!

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢咿咿……*咳咳**咕噜**噗*……咿咿嘢嘢咿咿！！！！
texts.en: HYEEEIIIIIIEEEIIEE.... *cough* *hark* *sputter* ...EEEEEIIIIEEEEE!!!!!

texts.zh: 你有东西要我们去砸，泥蛮？[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很擅长砸东西！
texts.en: You have something for us to smash, dwamak? [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural] very good at smashing!

texts.zh:
虚空之母今天非常愤怒。我能感觉到。

我们还需要更加努力地取悦她……
texts.en:
She of the Void is wroth today. I can feel it.

We have not done enough to win Her favor...

texts.zh:
我只是她的仆从。我对你一无所知。

但她……她看穿了你的蠕虫本质。
texts.en:
I am but Her servant. I know nothing.

But She... She sees you for the maggots that you are.

texts.zh: 每当你的飞船穿越无垠太空时，都是在冒犯她的领域。而我们则在竭力安抚她的愤怒。须知，她的愤怒非常可怕……
texts.en: Whenever your ships cross the vastness of space, they violate Her domain with their presence. It is left to us to sooth Her anger. It is terrible to behold...

texts.zh: 第九次教义战争已经进行到了第167周期。异端派系还在负隅顽抗……为了虚空之母，我们绝不会手下留情。
texts.en: The Ninth Doctrinal War is in its 167th cycle. The heretical factions simply will not yield... but for the sake of Her, we must not relent.

texts.zh: 说吧，外来者。我们的战士们正洗耳恭听。
texts.en: Speak then, outsider. Our warriors are listening.

texts.zh: 我们绝不向异形屈服。
texts.en: We bow to no alien.

texts.zh:
作为决斗失败的惩罚，我不得不按约定在这一轮中负责跟外来者打交道。

你来干哈？
texts.en:
As punishment for losing a duel, it has been decreed that I am to deal with all outsiders this cycle.

What do you want?

texts.zh: 解释一下你为什么要打扰我们。我们仍在继续战斗任务。
texts.en: Explain this interruption. There are battles to attend to.

texts.zh:
啊！终于来了个真正的军人！

[Root.GetSpeciesName]军队的战斗力我们也有所耳闻。成千上万的[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]迫切地想在战场上亲自挑战你们。

texts.zh:
哈！你想让我们对你的其中一名宿敌进行突袭？

我们不想插手你们之间的无聊纷争，但如果你开的价合适的话，我们倒是也可以考虑……

你想让我们攻击谁呢？
texts.en:
Ha! So you would have us raid one of your rivals?

We are loathe to get involved in your petty disputes, but with the proper incentives, I suppose it could be arranged...

Who is it that you want us to attack?

texts.zh:
你、你想让我们去袭击你的其中一个泥蛮宿敌？好的，可以……

但你要我们去袭击哪个泥蛮呢？
texts.en:
You... you want us to smash one of your dwamak rivals? Yes, it can be done...

But which dwamak to smash?

texts.zh:
既然你给我们进贡了，我们可以考虑去袭击一些无信仰者。

你打算让我们去袭击谁呢？
texts.en:
In exchange for tribute, we could perhaps be convinced to smite a particular group of unbelievers.

Who are these heretics you would have us deal with?

texts.zh: [preliminary_target.GetName]对我们的战士来说确实是合适的袭击目标，我们可以考虑对他们下手……
texts.en: The [preliminary_target.GetName] does indeed look like a ripe target for our warriors. Perhaps a visit is in order...

texts.zh: 没错，这个[preliminary_target.GetName]做泥蛮汤再合适不过了。很棒。但好像挺费劲……
texts.en: Yes, [preliminary_target.GetName] would make good dwamak-stew. Very good. But it is much effort...

texts.zh: 虚空之母对[preliminary_target.GetName]的无信仰者极为不满，应该进行一次战略远征来贯彻虚空之母的意愿……
texts.en: She of the Void does not look kindly on the heathens of the [preliminary_target.GetName]. A military expedition might serve Her will...

label.zh: 我们会给你们付钱的，请好好教训他们。
label.en: We'll pay. Teach them a lesson.

texts.zh:
整个星系中最强的是[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName]雇佣兵，这帮家伙虽然看着很粗野，但其纪律性堪称一流。为了贯彻自己的荣耀，他们甚至会按照雇主的要求去攻击其他的[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

这些是目前能够雇佣的舰队。
texts.en:
[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are the finest in the entire galaxy. Do not let their rowdy nature deceive you - when battle is joined, their discipline is second to none. Their honor would even compel them to fight against other [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural], should you wish it.

These are the fleets that are currently available for hire.

texts.zh:
哪怕是最强的泥蛮战士也敌不过[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName]的婴孩，嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！这可是众所周知的。

但这些可不是婴孩！！！这些强悍的[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName]佣兵打起仗来可是十分恐怖的！他们愿意为你这样的泥蛮效力，也愿意攻打其他的泥蛮，如果你开的价合适的话，他们甚至愿意攻击[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！

目前可雇佣的[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName]舰队名单如下：
texts.en:
Even [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName] infants can defeat bestest dwamak warriors. HYEEIIEE!!!! It is known.

But these not infants!!! These hardened [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries, and they be not only dangerous, but they be DERANGED! They willing to fight for dwamaks like YOU, against other dwamaks or even [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... if you pay!

Here current list of crazy [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName] fleets:

texts.zh:
我们的战士中有一些人认为消灭无信者是在贯彻虚空之母的意愿，哪怕是因为其他无信者的命令。他们会毫不犹豫的消灭其他的[marauder_country_3.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因为在这些激进分子眼中，除了自己之外，其他人都是异端。

不过不要担心。他们不会蠢到攻击雇主的。顺带说一句，我也很安全：因为他们的工作是我给找的，而我也能从他们获得的利润中分一杯羹。

这些是目前可以雇佣的舰队：
texts.en:
There are several cults among our warriors who feel that killing unbelievers, even at the behest of other unbelievers, aligns with Her will. They will not even shrink away from killing other [marauder_country_3.GetSpeciesNamePlural], since these radicals see everyone but themselves as heretics.

Not to worry, though. They are not foolish enough to attack their employer. Incidentally, I too am safe from their wrath, since I bring them work in exchange for a modest cut of their profits.

These are the fleets currently available for hire:

label.zh: 算了，让我们讨论下其他事务吧。
label.en: Never mind. Let us discuss other matters.

texts.zh:
哈哈，你脑子被踢坏了吧，外来者！你想让我们帮你去对抗那些古圣？

这我得拒绝。
texts.en:
Haha! You are truly mad, outsider. You would have us go up against the old ones?

I think not.

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢！！！！

不，泥蛮，虽然我们一向行事疯癫，但我们还没有疯狂到敢去攻击那些堕落的泥蛮。
texts.en:
HYEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!!!!!

No. Dwamak, we mad, but not mad enough to try bash fallen-dwamaks.

texts.zh:
虽然他们是无信仰者，但现在对他们发起攻击无异于以卵击石，这并不是虚空之母的意愿。

要收拾他们的话，至少也得等一两千年以后才行。
texts.en:
Though they are unbelievers, She of the Void would not have us throw away our ships in a vain attempt to smite the elder races.

Their time will come... in a millennium or two.

texts.zh:
恭喜，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，有了这支刚雇佣的舰队，你就可以袭击[random_fallen_empire.GetName]了！

哎呀，可能现在还不是动手的时候。不过有一件事是确定无疑的：这支佣兵舰队的实力很强！
texts.en:
Congratulations, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. With the fleet you have just hired, you could storm the [random_fallen_empire.GetName]!

Well, perhaps not. But make no mistake: it is a powerful force!

texts.zh: 这支舰队是你的了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。谨记：一个[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName]至少可以匹敌其他种族的十名战士。你可以以此来调整你的军力计算。
texts.en: The flotilla is yours, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Remember: a single [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName] is worth at least ten warriors of any other species. You may adjust your force calculations accordingly.

texts.zh: 你的选择是正确的，泥蛮！既然你雇佣了这支狂暴的[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，其他的泥蛮就无法雇佣他们来攻击你了！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！！
texts.en: You make wise decision, dwamak! By hiring these unstable [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you make certain some other dwamak not hire them and send them after you! HYEEEIIIIEEE!!!!

texts.zh: 这些圣战士们会好好为你效力的，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。但有一点要注意，不要登他们的船。他们将自己的船视为神圣之物，任何胆敢上他们船的无信仰者将会受到虚空之母的惩罚。
texts.en: These holy warriors will serve you well, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Just... do not trespass on their ships. They are considered sacred, and She of the Void would not look kindly on any unbelievers who tread on their hallowed decks.

texts.zh:
好，这可以安排，我们有许多厉害的战士在寻找新的挑战和机遇。

如果你能提供足够好的价码来使他们废除与同族所立下的誓约，那他们就可以对你宣誓效忠并为你而战。
texts.en:
Yes, this can be arranged. Many of our greatest warriors are searching for new challenges and opportunities.

If you can afford the price to release them from their sworn service to their kinfolk, they will gladly swear an oath to follow you and fight your battles.

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！没错，没错！许多精明的[marauder_species.GetName]战士们很乐意为泥蛮而战呢！只要开的条件合适的话就行。
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEEEEEE!! Yes, yes! Many smart [marauder_species.GetName] warriors glad to fight for dwamak moolah! Only need right incentive.

texts.zh:
是的，我们最强的战士们很乐意领导你的士兵们去战斗。有了你的能量币的支持，我们就能更好的服侍虚空之母了。

我们的战士们之所以英勇且战斗力强，就是因为他们毕生服侍虚空之母。
texts.en:
Yes, our greatest warriors are willing to lead your soldiers into battle. With the support of your energy credits, we will be able to serve Her with even greater fervor.

You will find that a lifetime of serving She of the Void has made our officers both fearless and effective.

texts.zh:
失去母星系似乎对[Root.GetName]的[marauder_species.GetName]雇佣兵造成了很大的打击。尽管我们与他们签订的五年契约还没有到期，可那些家伙竟然连人带船全跑的没影了！

他们最后留下的通讯信息是：

我们一定会报仇的。
texts.en:
The loss of their home systems seem to have badly shaken the [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries in the [Root.GetName]. In spite of the five-year contract we signed with them, the treacherous brigands and all of their ships have vanished into deep space!

Their last transmission, apparently a code-phrase to signal their departure, was:

"Vengeance shall be ours."

texts.zh: 大可汗麾下[raider_khanate.GetName]的崛起让很多同我们签订契约的[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]雇佣兵陷入了民族主义的狂潮，这些雇佣兵无视与我们签订的契约，并纷纷倒戈加入了大可汗的阵营。
texts.en: The rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName] under their vaunted Great Khan has triggered mass defections among all of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries that were in our employ! Caught up in a sudden influx of nationalistic fervor, the traitors have all abandoned their contracts and left to join the Great Khan's growing war machine.

texts.zh:
注意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

如果你们想让其他人替你们当炮灰冲锋陷阵的话，可以去雇佣[marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]佣兵舰队。如果你能出得起他们要的价格，你就能得到宇宙中最强的佣兵部队。
texts.en:
Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

If you have need of others to fight your battles for you, know that [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenary fleets are now available for hire. Yes, you heard correctly. If you can meet their prices, the best mercenaries in the galaxy are now willing to fight for you.

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！听好了，泥蛮们！

我们的战士们由于闲的实在无聊，已经开始内斗了，死伤无数！不过我们有办法解决……我们决定派我们最厉害的战士们去为泥蛮效命，当然你们必须支付能源！如果你们想要宇宙中最强的佣兵部队支援你们，就赶快行动吧！
texts.en:
HYEEEIIIEEEEEE!!!! Attention, dwamaks!

Our warriors grow bored and cause much trouble! Much fighting with each other, many dead! But we have solution... we send our craziest warriors to fight for dwamaks, in exchange for credits! If you want best mercenaries in galaxy, hurry now before too late!

texts.zh:
全知全能的虚空之母有一条消息给你：

虚空之母已然知晓你所渴望之物，你现在可以雇佣一些我们的佣兵舰队。我们的船员皆为训练有素之士，若能够提供足够的报酬，他们皆会服从于你的命令。

这是一份难以置信的礼物，请不要浪费她的一番好意。
texts.en:
She of the Void has a message for you:

If you so desire, you may now hire some of our fleets as mercenaries. Our crews are disciplined and will obey your instructions, as long as you can meet our prices.

This is an incredible gift that She has bestowed upon you. Do not squander it.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]的弱者们，我们的战士们正准备去进攻你们的星系，要么勇敢的面对他们、要么像懦夫一样躲起来眼睁睁的看着我们的战士抢走你们的财富。

当然了，你们也可以现在就进贡，如果贡品价值足够的话，我们可以考虑不攻击你们……
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName] weaklings, our warriors are on their way to plunder your systems. Face them in battle if you can muster the courage, or cower in fear until they have had their fill of your riches.

You can, of course, offer tribute now to spare yourselves from the coming onslaught. If it is sufficient, our warriors may be compelled to turn back...

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！！[Root.GetSpeciesName]——泥蛮！我们来你们星系串门来了！顺便来抢些东西，省的你们因为过于富有而变得肥的流油！

除非你们能找出不让我们这么做的理由……
texts.en:
HYEEEIIIIIEEEEEE!!!!!!! [Root.GetSpeciesName]-dwamaks! We come visit your systems! We save you from growing too rich and fat, yes!

Unless you think of reason why you not make good dwamak-stew...

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。虚空之母已降下圣训，希望能用你们的星系作为祭所来庆祝她对这片虚空的永恒支配权。我们是虚空之母忠实的仆从，我们必须贯彻虚空之母的意愿。

一支由我们最优秀的战士所组成的舰队正前往你们星系收集祭品。或者如果你们愿意满足虚空之母的饥饿，也可以现在就主动进贡，如果贡品数目足够的话，我们也可以停止对你们的攻击。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. She of the Void has communicated to us Her desire to use your systems as ceremonial sites from which to celebrate Her ever-lasting dominion over Space. As Her humble servants, we have no choice but to comply.

A battle fleet of our finest warriors, drawn from all of our warring factions, is currently on its way to you to gather tribute and servants. To stave off the inevitable and sate Her hunger, you may offer tribute now. If it is sufficient, the fleet will be recalled.

label.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。
label.en: You'll get nothing from us, scum.

label.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。
label.en: You'll get nothing from us, scum.

label.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。
label.en: You'll get nothing from us, scum.

texts.zh: 你们终于哭丧着跑来乞求怜悯了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? 你们仍旧可以献上贡品来跪求我们远离你们的领土，但是我们要抬价。
texts.en: Have you finally come to grovel for mercy then, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You may still offer tribute to secure our withdrawal from your space, but the price has gone up.

texts.zh:
怎么，泥蛮？你们不想让我们来串门了？你们想让我们走？嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！

你们可以付钱，但价位也要跟着上涨……
texts.en:
Yes, dwamak? You no want us visit now? You want us go away? HYEEEIIEEEE!!!

You can pay, but more expensive now...

texts.zh:
吾姆为你渎神的言行感到愤怒，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……非常愤怒。我们在圣战中每活祭一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都会平息一丝她的愤怒，但这就够了吗？

如果你想向虚空之母献上贡品来让我们撤军，你最好清楚，她现在需要更多的祭品。
texts.en:
She is angry, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... very angry. Every [Root.GetSpeciesName] that is sacrificed in Her honor lessens her fury somewhat, but will it be enough?

If you are here to offer tribute to She of the Void as a means of securing our withdrawal from your space, know that she will require an even larger sacrifice on your behalf now...

texts.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]劫掠团登陆了[Root.GetName]！他们的舰队从轨道上部署了许多小型的攻击机，[marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在撤退前攻击了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上一些零散的聚居点。我们在地表上的防御部队根本没有时间反应。
texts.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding parties have made planetfall on [Root.GetName]! Deploying in small attack shuttles from their orbiting fleet, the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] hit several outlying settlements on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] before retreating back into space with their plunder. Our defensive forces on the surface had no time to respond.

texts.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的奴隶贩子登陆了[Root.GetName]！攻击机袭击了许多[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的定居点，俘获了许多殖民者，并给他们戴上镣铐抓上了掠夺者位于轨道的舰队。
texts.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] slavers have landed on [Root.GetName]! Attack shuttles hit several outlying settlements on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], rounding up colonists and transporting them back in chains to the raiders' orbiting fleet.

label.zh: 一定要让他们为此付出代价。

texts.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的少量军队对[Root.GetName]实行了一场一击脱离战。他们零零散散的空降登陆让指挥地面防御部队的战术反应单位一时摸不着头脑，直到这群野蛮人劫掠了定居点，安安稳稳地回到他们轨道上的舰队时才反应过来。
texts.en: Light [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] forces have conducted a hit-and-run attack on [Root.GetName]. Their dispersed landings confused the tactical response units leading our surface forces, and before they could react the raiders had already returned to orbit with whatever spoils they could gather from our settlements.

texts.zh:
[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的奴隶贩子登陆了[Root.GetName]！呼啸而过的攻击机倾泻炸弹之雨，敲开了有机体庇护所的大门，之后一群全副武装的劫掠团包围了庇护所。

不知所措的有机体们才从庇护所内安稳的美梦中醒来，被这些奴隶贩子俘获，带上了他们的轨道舰队。
texts.en:
[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] slavers have landed on [Root.GetName]! Bombing runs from their attack shuttles cracked open several of our organic sanctuaries, which were then stormed by heavily armed raiding parties.

The bewildered organics who had, until now, been kept safe within these sanctuaries were promptly rounded up by the slavers and returned in chains to their orbiting fleet.

texts.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠团登陆了[Root.GetName]！这些劫掠者劫掠了我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的一些哨站，并在回到轨道舰队之前屠杀了成百上千的子个体。
texts.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding parties have made planetfall on [Root.GetName]! The raiders plundered several of our outposts on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] and slaughtered hundreds of drones before they retreated back to their orbiting fleet.

texts.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesAdj]的劫掠团侵犯了[Root.GetName]！这些卑鄙的抢到洗劫了我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的许多设施，屠杀了数百个共生体之后返回了轨道舰队上。
texts.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesAdj] raiding parties have transgressed upon [Root.GetName]! These vile interlopers plundered several of our facilities on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] and slaughtered hundreds of symbionts before retreating back to their orbiting fleet.

label.zh: 我们必须要惩戒这种无耻行径。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，可以从你们的土拨鼠洞里钻出来了。我们从你们这“解放”了足够多的财富，现在正在用船载回去呢。

嗨！舵手伙计们！我们要回[marauder_system.GetName]了。让我们离开这群混球的地盘吧，这鬼地方真让我感到恶心。
texts.en:
You can emerge from your shelters now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have liberated a sufficient amount of your wealth, and our ships are loaded to capacity.

Helmsman! Set course for [marauder_system.GetName]. Let us depart this blasted region of space. It depresses me.

texts.zh:
泥蛮，我们已经抢够了，不需要再抢了，我们的船已经装不下了。

我们现在就回[marauder_system.GetName]吧。
texts.en:
Dwamaks, we have bashed enough. No more bashing needed now. Our ship holds full.

We go back [marauder_system.GetName] now, yes.

texts.zh: 圣战结束了。虚空之母对我们在你们领土上造成的毁坏感到满意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。现在她允许我们回到[marauder_system.GetName]了。
texts.en: The ceremony is concluded. She of the Void is satisfied with the destruction we have brought to your space, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are now permitted to return to [marauder_system.GetName].

texts.zh: 这很令人激动，不是吗？这场战争多么让人兴奋！我们最强大的战士将与你们最强的军队进行较量。让我们看看谁才是胜者吧！
texts.en: This is exciting, yes? The thrill of battle! Our best warriors pitted against the best you have to offer. We shall see who comes out on top!

texts.zh: 泥蛮，你有什么事？我们正在忙着洗劫你的地盘！
texts.en: Dwamak, what you want? We busy bashing your systems!

texts.zh: 我们只为吾母的意志而存在。虽然现在那些兜里有子儿的人雇佣我们来毁灭你们，但只要最终结果能让更多的异端者作为活祭献给吾母，吾母定然会同意我们的行为。
texts.en: We serve only Her will, and, for the moment, those with pockets deep enough to hire us to smite you. As long as the end result is more dead believers, She of the Void approves.

label.zh: 是谁雇佣你们来攻击我们的？
label.en: Who paid you to raid us?

label.zh: 是谁雇佣你们来攻击我们的？
label.en: Who paid you to raid us?

label.zh: 是谁雇佣你们来攻击我们的？
label.en: Who paid you to raid us?

texts.zh: 我们给[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队造成的巨大损失足以让他们停下劫掠的步伐。看来在考虑过所有可能的选项后，[marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终决定停止劫掠，回到他们的领土。
texts.en: The heavy damage inflicted upon the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding fleet has been enough to give pause to their warriors. After reconsidering their options, the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have apparently decided to abandon their raid and withdraw back to their own space.

label.zh: 他们自视甚高，结果自取其辱。
label.en: They bit off more than they could chew.

texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队试图劫掠我们的领土，但在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被全歼了。舰船残骸中没有发现任何幸存者。
texts.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] fleet that vowed to raid our space has been destroyed as the result of a fleet action in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system. No survivors have been reported found amongst the debris.

label.zh: 让这次惨败作为他们的教训吧。
label.en: Let this be a lesson to their kind.

texts.zh: 那个在我们“一番鼓励”之后决定对[marauder_target.GetName]发起劫掠的[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]掠夺者夹着尾巴逃回了他们自己的星系！他们的劫掠舰队受损严重，让他们放弃了原来的劫掠计划。
texts.en: The [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] marauders that we "encouraged" to launch a raid against the [marauder_target.GetName] have turned tail and are running back to their own space! The losses sustained by their raiding fleet were apparently grave enough to give them a change of heart.

texts.zh: 一支[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesName]舰队正在朝我们的边境驶来！我们截获了该舰队的通讯，他们是受敌对国雇佣来袭击我们的星系的，他们现在正在从公开频道上给我们发送消息。
texts.en: A [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesName] raiding fleet has been detected approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rivalling foreign power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message directed towards us on an open channel.

texts.zh: 一个属于此前未知物种的私掠舰队正在侵入我们的边境！这些自称[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的野蛮人显然是受到与我们敌对的境外势力支持后来攻击我们的领土。他们正在从公开频道向我们发送信息。
texts.en: A raiding fleet belonging to a previously unknown species has been detected approaching our borders! These savages, who call themselves the [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural], have apparently been paid by a rivalling foreign power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message directed towards us on an open channel.

texts.zh: 躲在阴影中的胆小鬼们想利用我们来借刀杀人，因为这帮蛆虫太过畏惧不敢亲自动手。[Root.GetSpeciesName]的战士中究竟有没有人有足够的勇气与我们在战场上光荣的一决胜负，亦或是毫不还手让我们劫掠你们的领土？向我们展示你们的尊严！
texts.en: Cowards huddling in darkness have asked us to face you, since they are too afraid to do so themselves. Are there any [Root.GetSpeciesName] warriors honorable enough to meet us in open battle, then, or must we plunder your systems unopposed? Show us your worth!

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！你们的敌人可不少哦，泥蛮！那些敌人雇我们来破坏你们的星系！我们很乐意代劳哦！
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! You have many enemies, dwamak! They not like you very much! Even pay us to bash your systems! We happy to oblige!

texts.zh: 如果一群异端付钱让我们去消灭另一群异端，我们为什么拒绝呢？我们迟早会处理掉所有异教徒，但至少现在我们会针对你们。
texts.en: If one group of unbelievers wants us to smite another group of unbelievers, and are willing to pay us for it, who are we to say no? In time, the servants of She of the Void will deal with all heretics, but for now we shall focus on you.

texts.zh: 在我们的一番“鼓励”之下，[raid_parent.GetSpeciesNamePlural]向[raid_victim.GetName]派遣了劫掠舰队。现在舰船上装满了战利品和奴隶，已经准备返航了。船主们纷纷表示这次袭击非常的成功。
texts.en: The raiding fleet that the [raid_parent.GetSpeciesNamePlural] sent into the [raid_victim.GetName] after we "encouraged" them to do so has set a course back to their home system. With the fleet's cargo holds full of captured loot and slaves, the ship masters have declared the raid successfully concluded.

texts.zh: 在我们的唆使下，[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所组成的私掠舰队在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被[fleet_destroyer.GetName]摧毁了！没有幸存者的相关报告。
texts.en: The raiding fleet that we "encouraged" the [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put together has been destroyed in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system by forces belonging to the [fleet_destroyer.GetName]! There are no reports of survivors.

label.zh: 希望他们在被消灭前给敌人造成了一些伤害。
label.en: They hopefully did some damage at least.

texts.zh:
[great_khan.GetName]，[From.GetName]的大可汗，[great_khan.GetHerHis]自吹自擂称自己是军事天才 ，却在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭受了可耻的失败。[great_khan.GetSheHe]指挥的舰队在与[khan_destroyer.GetName]的舰队交战中被击溃时，大可汗和[great_khan.GetHerHis]的侍从们却乘着小型运输机逃进超空间航道四散逃离。.

尽管到现在，[great_khan.GetName]仍在筹备一支新的舰队重新开始[great_khan.GetHerHis]的争战，但这次伟大的胜利将给一切反抗贪得无厌的[From.GetName]侵略者的国家带来巨大鼓舞。
texts.en:
In spite of [great_khan.GetHerHis] vaunted military genius, [great_khan.GetName], the Great Khan of the [From.GetName], has met with defeat in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system. When the armada [great_khan.GetSheHe] [great_khan.GetWasWere] commanding was lost in battle against forces belonging to the [khan_destroyer.GetName], the Great Khan and [great_khan.GetHerHis] closest officers fled into hyperspace in a small shuttlecraft.

Even now, [great_khan.GetName] is busy assembling a new armada to resume [great_khan.GetHerHis] conquests, but this victory has brought some much needed respite to those who oppose the relentless advance of the [From.GetName].

label.zh: 看来大可汗并非不可战胜。
label.en: So the Great Khan is not infallible.

texts.zh:
吾乃[From.GetName]之天可汗，[great_khan.GetName]。吾在[khan_destroyer.GetRealName]的挫败不过只是寸兵尺铁的损失罢了。[khan_destroyer.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一群勇敢的战士，是可敬的对手，但他们仍逃不了被吾击败的命运。

星河潮流浩浩荡荡，顺之者昌，逆之者亡。我的全新舰队已经筹备好了。在战争结束后，所有支持我的辖区总督们都会得到我的封赏。
texts.en:
This is Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [From.GetName]. My defeat at the hands of the [khan_destroyer.GetRealName] was a minor setback - nothing more. The [khan_destroyer.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are brave warriors and worthy opponents, but they, too, will fall before us.

The tide of history is sweeping across the galaxy, and nothing can stop it. My new armada has been assembled. After this war is over, my loyal Satraps shall be rewarded for their support.

texts.zh:
吾乃[From.GetName]之天可汗，[great_khan.GetName]。吾在[khan_destroyer.GetRealName]的挫败不过只是寸兵尺铁的损失罢了。[khan_destroyer.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一群勇敢的战士，是可敬的对手，但他们仍逃不了被吾击败的命运。

星河潮流浩浩荡荡，顺之者昌，逆之者亡。我的全新舰队已经筹备好了。宣誓臣服于我吧，趁着你们还有时间选择。
texts.en:
This is Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [From.GetName]. My defeat at the hands of the [khan_destroyer.GetRealName] was a minor setback - nothing more. The [khan_destroyer.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are brave warriors and worthy opponents, but they, too, will fall before us.

The tide of history is sweeping across the galaxy, and nothing can stop it. My new armada has been assembled. Swear fealty to me now, while you still have time.

texts.zh:
吾乃[From.GetName]之天可汗，[great_khan.GetName]。吾在[khan_destroyer.GetRealName]的挫败不过只是寸兵尺铁的损失罢了。[khan_destroyer.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一群勇敢的战士，是可敬的对手，但他们仍逃不了被吾击败的命运。

星河潮流浩浩荡荡，顺之者昌，逆之者亡。我的全新舰队已经筹备好了。逆我者亡。
texts.en:
This is Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [From.GetName]. My defeat at the hands of the [khan_destroyer.GetRealName] was a minor setback - nothing more. The [khan_destroyer.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are brave warriors and worthy opponents, but they, too, will fall before us.

The tide of history is sweeping across the galaxy, and nothing can stop it. My new armada has been assembled. All who attempt to stand in my way shall be vanquished.

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

texts.zh:
大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了。[great_khan.GetHerHis]的舰队在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭遇了第二次失败，在舰队被[khan_destroyer.GetName]击败后，大可汗没有尝试逃跑，而是决心与[great_khan.GetHerHis]的旗舰一同赴死.

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[From.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的军阀们正兵戎相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的控制权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
texts.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] is dead. After [great_khan.GetHerHis] armada met with defeat a second time in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system, the Great Khan made no attempt to escape [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship when it was destroyed in battle by the [khan_destroyer.GetName].

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [From.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other for control over [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

texts.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
texts.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！根据我们截获到的信息，大可汗的死因是没能抵御住名为萨拉凯利安热病的病魔侵袭，这是[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的一种常见而致命的疾病，是[raider_khanate.GetName]崛起前其太空站恶劣生活环境的遗产。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! According to intercepted communications, the Great Khan succumbed to Sarakellian Fever, a relatively common and often fatal disease found among [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a legacy of the poor living conditions on the space stations where most of them lived before the rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName].

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了! 截留到的信息显示，大可汗是被一个未知的星际势力派遣出的特种部队刺杀。目前没有任何一个政府对此事表示负责。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Intercepted communications suggest that the Great Khan was violently assassinated by a special forces team in the employ of an as yet unidentified galactic power. No government has been willing to claim responsibility for this operation.

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是在[great_khan.GetHerHis]旗舰上[great_khan.GetHerHis]的私人房间被一名外星姬妾刺杀。刺杀动机不明。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are vague, but intercepted transmissions have revealed that the Great Khan was murdered by an alien concubine in [great_khan.GetHerHis] private chambers onboard [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship. The motive is unknown.

texts.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗死了！根据目前截留到的信息，[great_khan.GetName][great_khan.GetHerHis]由于年老，在几天前无疾而终了。

尽管人们相信可汗指定了一位继承人，但[raider_khanate.GetName]还是掀起了一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主们正为了争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产——帝国的控制权而兵戎相见，究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
texts.en:
The Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead. According to intercepted transmissions, [great_khan.GetName] passed away naturally at some point during the last few days as a result of [great_khan.GetHerHis] advanced age.

It is believed that the Great Khan had appointed a designated successor, but despite this a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

texts.zh:
尽管大可汗是否还会重出江湖、出现在某一支新舰队上的念头仍让人忧心忡忡，但从部落的全面失利看来这种可能性微乎其微。

虽然其尸首下落不明，但据信大可汗还是在最后一个部落的空间站和战舰被摧毁的时候战死了。
texts.en:
Despite concerns that the Great Khan would somehow resurface at the head of a new battle fleet, the utter defeat of the Horde seems to have made that impossible.

Although no body has been found, the Great Khan is believed to have died when the last of the Horde's stations and starships were destroyed.

texts.zh:
尽管大可汗是否还会重出江湖、出现在某一支新舰队上的念头仍让人忧心忡忡，但从部落的全面失利看来这种可能性微乎其微。

虽然其尸首下落不明，但据信大可汗还是在最后一个部落的空间站和战舰被摧毁的时候战死了。

与此同时，我们的船员仍继续在前可汗舰队的残骸中搜寻。他们发现了一座漂浮在太空中的巨大染血座椅，并且基本可以肯定这一张座椅就是大可汗的王座。
texts.en:
Despite concerns that the Great Khan would somehow resurface at the head of a new battle fleet, the utter defeat of the Horde seems to have made that impossible.

Although no body has been found, the Great Khan is believed to have died when the last of the Horde's stations and starships were destroyed.

Meanwhile, our crews have continued to sift through the wreckage of the Khan's former flagship. They found a large blood-stained chair floating in space, and are reasonably certain that this piece of furniture was, in fact, the Great Khan's throne.

texts.zh: 我决不会辜负[raider_khanate.GetName]。数十亿人正遵循我的引导。
texts.en: I will not fail the [raider_khanate.GetName]. Billions rely on my guidance.

texts.zh: 吾乃万汗之汗，[great_khan.GetName]。你是来臣服于我的统治的吗？
texts.en: This is Great Khan [great_khan.GetName]. Have you come to submit to my rule?

texts.zh: 有志者，事竟成。
texts.en: There is nothing impossible to him who will try.

texts.zh: 你已有幸面见大可汗。有什么话就说吧。
texts.en: You are in the presence of the Great Khan. Speak your mind.

texts.zh: 是谁请求面见大可汗？
texts.en: Who would seek an audience with the Great Khan?

texts.zh: 星光下还有更多的地盘等待我们征服。
texts.en: There are more worlds to conquer.

texts.zh: 我的子民经受了够多的苦难了。我将为他们在这片星河中开辟新的生存空间。
texts.en: My people have endured enough hardship. I will carve for them a new home amongst the stars.

texts.zh: 我为那些被我们的军队所戕害的生命流泪，但为了[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]的未来别无他法。.
texts.en: I weep for those who fall before my forces, but there is no other way if the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] people are to have a future.

texts.zh:
我正在建设的帝国将让整个星河受益。尽管现在看来它远非如此，但终有一天，它将成为这个宇宙里稳定而繁荣的灯塔，吸引着全宇宙所有智慧生命。

最终，和平之光将在这个星河闪耀。我一定会做到。
texts.en:
The empire I am building shall benefit the whole of the galactic community. It may not seem like it now, but one day it will become a beacon of stability and prosperity for all intelligent life forms.

Peace shall, at last, reign in the galaxy. I will make it so.

texts.zh: 我的朝廷永远对忠诚的总督们开放。你有什么事想问吗？
texts.en: My court is always open to my loyal Satraps. What would you ask of me?

texts.zh: 你是代表[Root.GetSpeciesName]的辖地，对吗？[Root.GetName]，好像是这个名字。大可汗能给你做点什么呢?
texts.en: You speak to me on behalf of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] Satrapy, yes? The... [Root.GetName], I believe. What can your Great Khan do for you?

texts.zh:
尽管你们不是有机生命体，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但所有臣服于[raider_khanate.GetName]的智慧生命都会被平等对待。

我发誓。
texts.en:
Your kind may not be organic, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but all forms of intelligent life that are subjects of the [raider_khanate.GetName] shall be treated equally.

This I swear.

texts.zh: 有时候我也会想，要是我像你一样是个机器人，很多事就简单多了。唉。
texts.en: Sometimes I think life would be far easier were I a machine like you. Alas.

texts.zh: 也就是说与我对话的是[Root.GetSpeciesName]的中心意识咯？真有趣。
texts.en: Is this the [Root.GetSpeciesName] central consciousness that I am addressing, then? Fascinating.

texts.zh: 听说[Root.GetSpeciesName]的无人机会无条件地服从蜂巢思维主脑的命令。只要你们的集体意识也像这样服从我，我们就能愉快相处。
texts.en: I understand that [Root.GetSpeciesName] drones obey the commands of their Hive Mind without question. As long as your Hive Mind serves me in a similar fashion, we shall have no problems.

texts.zh: 你接受我的统治是明智之举。这样就能确保[Root.GetSpeciesName]的幸福生活了。
texts.en: You were wise to submit to my rule. This decision saved countless [Root.GetSpeciesName] lives.

texts.zh: 你知道吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]其实十分相似。你们将在我建立的宇宙帝国中扮演重要的角色。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not very different, you know. Your kind will have an important role to play in the galactic empire we are building together.

texts.zh: 我相信了你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我给你在我的桌子前提供一席之地……你却用这种行为作为对我的报答。
texts.en: I trusted you, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I offered you a seat at my table... and in return, you spat in my face.

texts.zh: 我绝不容许反叛的行为。没什么好谈的了。
texts.en: I do not suffer traitors. We have nothing to discuss.

texts.zh:
背后捅刀的小人。你还好意思说自己想成为辖地？

你竟敢愚弄我，我绝不能原谅。
texts.en:
Treacherous scum. So you wanted to be a Satrapy, did you?

You made me look the fool, and that is something I cannot forgive.

texts.zh: 这可是私人恩怨，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
texts.en: You have made this personal, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

texts.zh:
你以及那些和你一样轻视感性生命的家伙们，正是我需要去坚实引领宇宙的原因。

你们的持续存在本身就是一个威胁。我决定终止这一威胁。
texts.en:
You and those who share your utter disregard for sentient life are why the galaxy is in such dire need of my firm guidance.

Your continued existence is a threat in and of itself. I mean to bring it to an end.

texts.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！泥蛮！你们正在……*咳嗽*

我、我是说，你正在与令人敬畏的大可汗对话，有话快说。
texts.en:
HYEEIIIIEEEEE, dwamak! You speak to... *cough*

I... I mean, you are in the august presence of the Great Khan. Speak thy mind.

label.zh: 我们想要讨论归顺的事……
label.en: We would like to discuss surrender...

label.zh: 我们想要讨论归顺的事……
label.en: We would like to discuss surrender...

label.zh: 你一个[From.GetSpeciesName]……口舌之活倒挺顺溜的嘛。
label.en: You seem very... articulate for a [From.GetSpeciesName].
What happened to "She of the Void"?

label.zh: 我们想要回我们的自治权。

texts.zh:
明智的选择。归顺之后，你将成为[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，需要为我们正在进行的战争提供人员与资源。然而，除此之外，你并不需要置身前线，在我们征服全星系之前，你只要料理好自己的事务就可以了。

成为辖地后将获得：
£energy£ -30% 能量币收入
£minerals£ -30% 矿物收入
£food£ -30% 食物收入
£navy_size£ -30% 舰队规模

[raider_khanate.GetName]会变得更加强大。
texts.en:
A wise choice. Upon your surrender, you will become a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and be expected to contribute resources and military personnel to our ongoing wars. Beyond that, however, you will not be required to take part in the actual fighting, and I am content to leave you to your own devices until we have secured the galaxy.

Becoming a Satrapy will result in:
£energy£ -30% Energy Credit income
£minerals£ -30% Mineral income
£food£ -30% Food income
£navy_size£ -30% Naval Capacity

The [raider_khanate.GetName] will grow more powerful.

label.zh: 你搞错了。我们是说要你归顺。
label.en: You misunderstand. We meant your surrender.

texts.zh:
[new_satrapy.GetName]已经归顺了大可汗！他们已成了[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，舰队也已解除了敌对状态。

虽然他们还没有正式加入[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对于星辰大海的伟大征程，但已经承诺为大可汗的战争机器提供资源与人员！
texts.en:
The [new_satrapy.GetName] has submitted to the Great Khan! They have been made a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and their fleets are now standing down.

Although they have not officially joined the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in their attempted conquest of the galaxy, they have pledged to contribute resources and military personnel to further bolster the Great Khan's war machine.

texts.zh: 为了“保护”我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]已在[capital_star.GetName]星系建立了一座大型军事基地，还驻扎了为数不小的舰队。这个基地的第二层用意似乎是为了鼓励我们尽快完成作为辖地的职责，并监督召集[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]加入大可汗舰队的进度。
texts.en: For our "protection" the [raider_khanate.GetName] has established a large military space installation in the [capital_star.GetName] system, defended by a sizable garrison fleet. The secondary role of this base appears to be to encourage us to fulfill our obligations as a Satrapy and to oversee the recruitment of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to serve in the Great Khan's battle fleets.

texts.zh:
好好考虑吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你再这样执迷不悟，可就没有回头路了。想再提出归顺，我是不会接受的。

胆敢进行反对的辖地，只有彻底消失一途。
texts.en:
Think this through, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If you go down this path, there will be no turning back. I will not accept a second surrender.

The only possible fate of a rebelling Satrapy is its complete destruction.

label.en: Oh. In that case, never mind.

texts.zh:
大可汗的逝去导致了[From.GetName]的崩溃。没有了强势的统治者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]又一次陷入了内斗。帝国在各个继业者，最强大也最有权势的高级军官们，的领导下分为数派。

每一派都自称为星帐的大可汗，不允许任何人的质疑。[From.GetSpeciesName]团结一心的日子走到了尽头。
texts.en:
The death of the Great Khan has proved the undoing of the [From.GetName]. Without a strong ruler to unite them, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have succumbed to infighting once more. Their empire has been divided between the Diadochi, the most powerful and influential of the Great Khan's military commanders.

Each of them now claims the title of Great Khan of the Galaxy, and their supporters are locked in bitter opposition to one another. The time of a united [From.GetSpeciesName] empire is apparently at an end.

label.en: It was not meant to be.

texts.zh:
大可汗去世之前，有很多的改革工作正在进行中，旨在将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从一个个松散无序的部族变成一个团结有力的星际帝国。现在大可汗的去世让这所有的改革瞬间消失殆尽。

所有继承大可汗的军阀们都没有对这些改革展现一丝兴趣，而[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也都回归了以前的掠夺者行事方式。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成一盘散沙。
texts.en:
The death of the Great Khan has also proved the killing blow for the many reforms that were instituted by the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to turn their disorganized marauder clans into a consolidated galactic empire.

None of the warlords who succeeded the Great Khan have shown the least bit of interest in continuing these reforms, and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have all reverted to the old ways of their violent marauder past. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are united no longer.

texts.zh:
出人意料地，[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国成功挺过了大可汗死后的种种波动。由于新可汗立刻加冕，也完全消灭了大家分道扬镳的念头。

目前来说，重获新生的[From.GetSpeciesName]似乎把重心放在了巩固已有疆土之上，对于新的征程兴趣不大。
texts.en:
Against all odds, the [From.GetSpeciesName] Horde has managed to weather the turmoil that followed in the wake of the death of the Great Khan. The immediate threat of splintering into different successor states has been largely eliminated with the coronation of a new khan.

For now, this reborn [From.GetSpeciesName] Khanate seems more concerned with the consolidation of the territory it already controls than making new conquests.

label.zh: 就看看他们能苟活到什么时候。
label.en: We shall see how long they survive.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]在大可汗死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

作为汗国的辖地，我们受邀作为奠基成员加入该联邦。除此之外，汗国最近还起草了一份宪法，允许我们脱离，以及重新建立完全独立的主权。
texts.en:
The power struggle that erupted in the [From.GetName] upon the death of the Great Khan has come to an end. A new democratic faction, inspired by egalitarian values that were alien to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] when they began their war of conquest, now seeks to reform their government along the lines of an interstellar federation.

As a Satrapy of the Horde, we have been asked to participate in this new federation as a founding member. Alternatively, the Horde's recently drafted constitution would also allow us to secede and establish full independence once again.

label.zh: 我们就加入这个新的联邦吧。
label.en: We shall join this new federation.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]在大可汗死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

汗国的前辖地都收到了作为平等个体加入该联邦的邀请，或者他们也可选择不加入并要回完全的独立主权。
texts.en:
The power struggle that erupted in the [From.GetName] upon the death of the Great Khan has come to an end. A new democratic faction, inspired by egalitarian values that were alien to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] when they began their war of conquest, now seeks to reform their government along the lines of an interstellar federation.

The former Satrapies of the Horde have been given the offer to join this new federation as equal partners, or to formally secede and have their full independence returned.

label.en: We shall see what comes of this.

texts.zh: <<大可汗的逝世使得[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国陷入了混乱。无人接听你的通讯。>>
texts.en: << The death of the Great Khan has thrown the [From.GetSpeciesName] Horde into disarray. No one is willing or able to receive your call. >>

label.zh: 那边到底是怎么回事啊？

texts.zh:
大可汗去世之后混乱和动乱随之而来，我们作为帝国中的辖地的历史一去不返——我们宣誓效忠的目标仅仅是大可汗。我们现在又可以追寻我们自己的命运了。

驻扎在[Root.Capital.solar_system.GetName]的汗国全体军事人员都离开他们的哨所回到自己的人民当中去了，第一次拆除之后剩余的军事用品都留在了那里。
texts.en:
With chaos and instability following in the wake of the Great Khan's death, our status as a Satrapy within the Horde is void - our oath of fealty was to the Great Khan alone. We are once more free to pursue our own destiny.

All Horde military personnel that were stationed in the [Root.Capital.solar_system.GetName] system have abandoned their posts to join their people elsewhere, after first demolishing any war material left behind.

texts.zh: 由于新汗国在维持大可汗的征伐时遇到困难，其将军决定进一步巩固其战斗军力。因此，他们从各附庸国的驻军空间站中调取了全部人员，并拆除了空间站。
texts.en: As the New Khanate struggles to maintain its hold over the Great Khan's conquests, its military leadership has decided to further consolidate their forces. Consequently, they have withdrawn the personnel from all of their vassal garrison stations and scuttled them.

texts.zh:
在仔细搜索了大可汗旗舰的残骸后，我们的部队发现一把沾满[FROM.GetBloodType]的大椅子漂浮在太空中。我们有充足的理由推定，这件家具实际上是大可汗的王座。

这件遗珍目前已被放在一个安全的保险库里。
texts.en:
After sifting through the wreckage of the Great Khan's flagship, our forces found a large [FROM.GetBloodType]-stained chair floating in space. We are reasonably certain that this piece of furniture is, in fact, the Great Khan's throne.

The relic has been placed inside a secure vault.

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！这是谁？你开着其他泥蛮部族的飞船，真是太逊了诶。怎么了？赌博输掉了你的舰队？
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Who this? You fly ships from other dwamak clan, but look weak. What happen? Lose your fleet in gamble?

texts.zh: 这不是我们最喜欢的星蛮子吗！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！你比把你赶出去的星蛮子好多了。
texts.en: If it not our favorite dokwaks! HYEEEIIIEEE!!! You better than the dwakam who kicked you out.

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢——等等。你们不是住行星上的泥蛮子。你们是来调查上次袭击的吗？有人派你们来夺回他们的矿石？
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEE- wait. You not planet-bound dwamaks. You here about last raid? Someone send you to grab back their minerals?

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢咿咿……*咳咳**咕噜**噗*……咿咿嘢嘢咿咿！！！！
texts.en: HYEEEIIIIIIEEEIIEE.... *cough* *hark* *sputter* ...EEEEEIIIIEEEEE!!!!!

texts.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！大星蛮子来啦！快，开好频道！
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Big dokwak arrives! Quick, open good channel!

texts.zh: 嘿咿咿咿！泥蛮部族的酋长在此！我们现在归您麾下了。有什么吩咐，大佬？
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! Dokwak-chief is here! We fly under your banner now. What you need, boss?

texts.zh: 嘿咿咿咿！我们认识你。你很能杀，而且还有牙齿。你想要什么？
texts.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! We know you. You killed good and you still have teeth. What you want?

texts.zh: 你可能已被你的人民抛弃，但并非无可救药。在虚空之母的关怀之下，任何人都能崛起，只要你提供的了价值。
texts.en: You may have been forsaken by your own people, yet not beyond redemption. In the embrace of She of the Void any can rise, if you are worthy.

texts.zh: 你的舰船经过此地已经冒犯了我们伟大的夫人。我们将代表你向她请愿。
texts.en: Your ships passing has upset our great Lady. We will petition Her on your behalf.

texts.zh:
你还活着？那很好。我们以为你已被那些追捕你的异端特工解决了。

不，我们不是指你以前的部族。我们说的是真正的敌人。
texts.en:
You yet live? That is good. We thought you be unmade by the heretical agents sent after you.

No, we do not mean your former clan. We speak of the true Foe.

texts.zh: 虚空之母看着你，露出了微笑。你和朋友在一起。[marauder_country_3.GetName]今天能为你提供什么帮助？
texts.en: She of the Void sees you and smiles. You are with friends. How can the [marauder_country_3.GetName] support you today?

texts.zh: 虚空圣子。我等信徒今日可为您效劳，以实现她的宏图大愿？
texts.en: Chosen of the Void. How may we followers help you enact Her vision today?

texts.zh: 虚空之母看到了此番安排，并未反对。我们任凭您的差遣。您的意志为何？
texts.en: She of the Void sees this arrangement and does not object. We are yours to command. What is your will?

texts.zh: 你已飞越漫漫长路。虚空之母并未忘记你的试炼。是什么让你来到我们这里？
texts.en: You have flown the long path. She of the Void has not forgotten your trials. What brings you to us?

label.en: Can you help us against the [marauder_country_1.GetName]?

label.zh: 机不可失，帮我们阻止那个篡权者！
label.en: Now or never, help us stop the pretender!

label.zh: 我们已准备好再次接收你们的增援。
label.en: We are ready to receive your reinforcements again.
Can you help us against the [marauder_country_1.GetName]?

label.zh: 机不可失，帮我们阻止那个篡权者！
label.en: Now or never, help us stop the pretender!

label.zh: 我们已准备好再次接收你们的增援。
label.en: We are ready to receive your reinforcements again.

texts.zh: 我们以前的部族拒绝接受我们的通讯。现在我们是孤军作战。
texts.en: Our former clan refuses to accept our communications. We are alone.

texts.zh:
我们的通讯再次遭到拒绝。作为回应，我们收到了一条自动消息：

“汗王尚未准备好接受你们的投降。待到战争的鼓声响起时再回来吧。”
texts.en:
Once again our communications are rejected. In response we recive an automated message:

"The Khan is not ready to accept your surrender yet. Return once the drums of war have sounded."

label.zh: 我们会让他们承认我们。
label.en: We will make them acknowledge us.

texts.zh:
你竟敢再次联系我们？

只是走运成功几次你就趾高气扬得以为自己是个军阀了一样。虚空吞噬勇者，也同样吞噬愚者。别把运气误认为是实力。
texts.en:
You dare contact us again?

A few lucky strikes, and already you strut like a warlord. The void claims the bold and the foolish in equal measure. Do not mistake chance for skill.

texts.zh:
你的名字玷污了我们的通信渠道，你的苟活蒙蔽了我们的荣誉。以此为终。下次我们派遣舰队追击你时，为了节省大家的时间，请直接关掉你的护盾。

像真正的[Root.Species.GetSpeciesName]一样战死沙场吧。
texts.en:
You foul our communications with your name and stain our honor with your survival. End it the proper way. Next time we send a fleet after you, save us all the time and just deactivate your shields.

Die in battle like a true [Root.Species.GetSpeciesName].

texts.zh:
无论发生什么，虚空都不愿将你留下。我们从账簿上抹去了你的名字，烧毁了你的旗帜，将你的面孔作为给[Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]的警示教育。然而，你仍然在我们的装甲上刻下了自己的印记。我们派出了侦察队，然后是突击队，最后是舰队。部族开始私语，称放逐是一个错误。这样的碎碎念将在此终结。

你为何就是不肯去死？！
texts.en:
No matter what, the void refused to keep you. We erased you from the ledgers, burned your banners, and made your face the villain in [Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] stories. Still, you carve your mark into our plating. We sent flotillas, then squadrons, and now armadas. The clans begin to murmur that the exile was an error. Such talk ends here.

Why won't you die?!

texts.zh: 欢迎回家，继承者们。今天需要我们为您做些什么？
texts.en: Welcome home Heirs. What do you need of us today?

texts.zh: 最近拿下了什么惊人的战果吗？我们刚跟一只体型巨大的缇扬奇交过手。它再生的速度比激光切割它的速度还要快。
texts.en: Scored any impressive kills recently? We had a run-in with a particularly large Tiyanki. It regenerated faster than lasers could cut it apart.

texts.zh: 啊，叛徒们回——啊抱歉，习惯了。今天星辰又带你去了何方？
texts.en: Ah the traitors retu- Ah sorry, old habits. Where have the stars taken you today?

label.zh: 能不能麻烦你停止那个烦人的尖叫呢？
label.en: Will you cease that infernal shrieking?

texts.zh: 欢迎回家，继承者们。今天需要我们为您做些什么？
texts.en: Welcome home Heirs. What do you need of us today?

texts.zh: 最近拿下了什么惊人的战果吗？我们刚跟一只体型巨大的缇扬奇交过手。它再生的速度比激光切割它的速度还要快。
texts.en: Scored any impressive kills recently? We had a run-in with a particularly large Tiyanki. It regenerated faster than lasers could cut it apart.

texts.zh: 啊，叛徒们回——啊抱歉，习惯了。今天星辰又带你去了何方？
texts.en: Ah the traitors retu- Ah sorry, old habits. Where have the stars taken you today?

texts.zh: 大可汗，您的威能令整个星系为之战栗。我们的舰队下一步该剑指何方？
texts.en: The galaxy trembles at your might, great Khan. Where shall we point our fleets next?

texts.zh:
万汗之汗！所有虚空港中，各部族皆高颂您的威名。我们静候您的号令。

今日，我们将焚尽哪些世界？
texts.en:
Khan of Khans! The clans sing your name in every void-port. We await your word.

What worlds do we burn today?

texts.zh: 大可汗！请给我们一个机会展示我们的勇气，让我们证明真正的忠诚度。当年将您驱逐是我们莫大的耻辱，若我们不配获得救赎，那就让我们在质量加速器的炮火中毁灭吧！
texts.en: Great Khan! Give us a chance to show you our mettle and let us prove our true loyalty. We are shamed by the day we cast you out, and if we are not worthy of redemption then let us die in mass driver fire!

label.zh: 在我方发出请求前，请暂留援军。
label.en: Hold your reinforcements until we call for them.

label.zh: 恢复向我方派遣增援部队。

texts.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是[capital_scope.GetName]。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
texts.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the [capital_scope.GetName] in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.

texts.zh:
我们再次击败了篡位者的爪牙。他们不会停止进犯，且下一次会变得更加凶猛。但是如果我们能摧毁足够多的敌人，或许连他们也会明白，想要抹除我们并非易事。

只要[capital_scope.GetName]仍在飘扬，我们的宣称就依然有效。我们要让他们知道，有些传承绝不会消亡。
texts.en:
We have defeated the agents of the usurper once more. They will not stop coming, and next time they will be stronger. If we break enough of them, perhaps even they will learn that we are not so easily erased.

As long as [capital_scope.GetName] flies, so too does our claim. We will teach them that some legacies refuse to die.

texts.zh: “住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在[From.GetName]上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。
texts.en: "Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the [From.GetName] hails from a ruptured bridge.

texts.zh:
被我们击败的敌方舰队很快就发出了投降信号。

“也打够了，这次是你们占了上风。现在，你要我们交出什么，好让我们能清洗船上的这个小污点，继续前进。”
texts.en:
The hostile fleet we defeated quickly signaled their surrender.

"That's enough of that. You've the better of us this time. Now, what must we hand over so we can polish this little blemish off the hull and move on."

texts.zh:
“我们投降了！求求你！你还记得我们吗？我们一直都忠于你的部族。所谓的流放根本就是个骗局。告诉我们怎样才能效力！”

[From.GetName]上的舰长似乎已经濒临崩溃，他们的[Root.Species.GetMouthName]颤抖着。
texts.en:
"We surrender! Please! You remember us; we were always loyal to your clan. This exile is a sham. Tell us how we can serve!"

The Captain aboard the [From.GetName] seems close to the edge, their [Root.Species.GetMouthName] trembling.

label.zh: 要么拿货要么拿命，你自己选。
label.en: Your cargo or your lives. The choice is yours.

label.zh: 就把这个当作是面试吧。最后谁能活下来谁就可以加入我们。
label.en: Consider this your interview. Last one breathing gets to join up.

label.zh: 我会让你们一个人瘸着回去，让他们知道将要面对什么。
label.en: We will send one of you limping. The next will know what's coming.

label.zh: 要么把你们舰队司令交出来，要么我们就自己从残骸里把他拖出来。
label.en: Give up your Admiral. Or we shall scrape them out of the wreckage.

texts.zh:
宏伟的舰队在[solar_system.GetName]严阵以待，傲慢地冠以大汗谕使之名。

然后，一声熟悉的呼唤不加修饰地传来：

“流亡者竟敢回来？难道就没有一点独自在黑暗中消亡、被耻辱地遗忘掉的自知之明吗？那我们就亲手了结你们。”

受选者的武器开始充能，我们其他的掠夺者同胞也严阵以待。在这样的决斗中，没有人会越界，因为结果将决定谁将成为他们的新一任可汗。
texts.en:
The grand fleet lies in wait at [solar_system.GetName], arrogantly bearing the name Chosen of the Great Khan.

Without fanfare, a familiar voice hails us:

"So the Exiled dare to return? No decency to die alone in the dark, forgotten and dishonored? Then we finish you ourselves."

As the Chosen power their weapons, the rest of our Marauder kin hold fast. None will trespass on such a duel, not when the outcome will determine who among them shall lead as Khan."

texts.zh:
指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬并效忠誓言。

我们做到了。王座是我们的了。
texts.en:
The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor and oaths of fealty.

We have done it. The throne is ours.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war.

label.zh: 可汗的时代结束了。让我们向你展示流放教会了我们什么。
label.en: The era of Khans is over. Let us show you what exile taught us.

label.zh: 大仇已报，剩下的人可以走了。
label.en: Vengeance has been served. The rest of you may go.

texts.zh:
指挥舱内的寂静被如潮水般涌入的信息炸裂声打破。集结的各氏族正以沸腾的喧嚣向他们的新冠军致敬。

然而，一切尚未结束。还有其他流亡者也拥有王位继承权。根据法律和习俗，他们必须在三年内向我们发起挑战，否则将永远沦为弃民。
texts.en:
The silence over our command bridge shatters as an explosion of messages cascades in. The assembled clans hail their new champion in riotous clamor.

However, it is not over. There are other exiles with a claim to the throne. By law and custom, they must challenge us within three years or remain outcasts forever.

texts.zh:
时机已到。我们那些胆小的对手已经放弃。所有其他潜在的篡位者都已处理完毕。氏族统一的力量正支持着我们。

终于，我们坐上了属于自己的王座。
texts.en:
It is time. Our cowardly rivals have given up. All other would-be usurpers have been dealt with. The unified might of the clans is behind us.

At last, we sit on our rightful throne.

label.en: Let sound the drums of war.

label.zh: 可汗的时代结束了。让我们向你展示流放教会了我们什么。
label.en: The era of Khans is over. Let us show you what exile taught us.

label.zh: 大仇已报，剩下的人可以走了。
label.en: Vengeance has been served. The rest of you may go.

texts.zh:
在前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]的途中，我们收到了令人沮丧的消息：一名和我们分庭抗礼的宣称者已经先于我们击败了目标。那位准大汗被击败了。现在，[From.GetName]宣称拥有了王座。

按照习俗，我们必须在三年内击败他们的旗舰，否则将丧失统治权。
texts.en:
On our way to [marauder_rally_point.GetName] we received crushing news: a rival claimant has beaten us to our quarry. The would-be Khan is defeated. Now the [From.GetName] claim the throne. 

By custom we must defeat their capital ship within three years, or forfeit our right to rule.

texts.zh: 在败给[From.GetName]后，我们必须放弃对汗位的宣称。现在我们只能眼睁睁地看着别人夺取王位。
texts.en: After our defeat at the hands of the [From.GetName] we must forfeit our claim to the Khanate. All we can do now is watch as someone else seizes the throne.

texts.zh:
我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。

现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。
texts.en:
Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.

Now we just have to decide what to do with the rest of the galaxy, there are many that wouldn't be familiar with our traditions and might accept our rule either way, but already they see weakness from our rule.

label.zh: 传统即是有理，我们将放弃我们的臣民。
label.en: Tradition is true, we will give up our subjects.
